description: Moving a session to the trash: the dialog, and what a host says when it doesn't.

messages.heading: Move “{$title}” to the trash?
messages.body: Its transcript will be moved to {$where}, where you can restore it.
messages.body_copies: .input {$n :number} .match $n one {{Its transcript and its {$n} earlier copy will be moved to {$where}, where you can restore it.}} * {{Its transcript and its {$n} earlier copies will be moved to {$where}, where you can restore it.}}
messages.host_refused: .input {$op :string} .match $op delete {{{$host} didn't delete it: {$why}}} archive {{{$host} didn't archive it: {$why}}} unarchive {{{$host} didn't unarchive it: {$why}}} * {{{$host} didn't {$op} it: {$why}}}
messages.codex_copy: Codex keeps its own copy of this session.
